subject: Package failing to be downloaded from Github when deploying app

messages.author: d9da78c108b20741
messages.subject: Package failing to be downloaded from Github when deploying app
parts:
HI,

I am receiving the following error when trying to deploy an app the uses a package I have on GitHub.


Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 535094225 failed: Error building image: Error fetching CoreAPI (0.1.0) source. Error accessing GitHub repository ceparman/CoreAPI. HTTP 401: Unauthorized
Execution halted

I am able to install the package with devtools::install_github("ceparman/CoreAPI) just fine.  I have deployed many apps with this package in the past with out issue.  The only change is I recently upgrade my account to include private repositories, but this one is public.
I have tried uninstalling the package and reinstalling from GitHub.  I have tried other packages in my Github account and get the same access error.

Any seen this issue?  Any ideas?

Thanks,
Craig

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Package failing to be downloaded from Github when deploying app
parts:
Could you try going to the Dashboard and select Account -> Profile from the left nav.
If Private Repository Access is not enabled, enable it. If it was already enabled, please disable it and re-enable it.
